title: Verify ordinary special pose task identity
changes: Connect the observed opcode 39 task allocation and callback to the ordinary special-pose reads in the recorded scene.
validation: Windows GNU build special-task-identity-build-kt4abqc0 and Wine special-task-identity-wine-s4quofvj passed. At frame 345 the interpreter observes opcode b95917, creator and allocator, then task callback 0812a8c4 with r0=020163cc before the allocator returns the same r0. Full state, central framebuffer and OAM match native continuation; no trace events dropped, protected inputs passed and Wine drained.

Protected static join special-task-identity-join-1zjiaoiz authenticates the EUR ROM, checks the observed order and return addresses, and verifies 0812569c calls 080059b8; 08005a68 loads the callback, passes the task and calls the 08145c14 BX r3 trampoline, matching callback link register 08005a71. Inputs passed and scratch was removed.
limitations: This establishes the allocation/callback link in one recorded interpreter frame. Native instruction attribution, full animation, other paths and complete checkpoint ancestry remain unproved; Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
